compose.name: api-read-update
compose.command: TASK_ID=$(curl -fsS http://localhost:8000/api/tasks | python -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["id"])'); curl -fsS -i http://localhost:8000/api/tasks/$TASK_ID && curl -fsS -i -X PUT http://localhost:8000/api/tasks/$TASK_ID -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"DONE"}'

compose.name: database
compose.command: docker compose -p session21-evidence exec -T postgres psql -U taskboard -d taskboard -c 'SELECT title, session_number, due_date, status FROM tasks; SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version;'

compose.name: non-root
compose.command: docker compose -p session21-evidence exec -T backend id && docker compose -p session21-evidence exec -T frontend id

hpa.name: hpa-pods
hpa.command: kubectl -n session21 get hpa,pods && kubectl -n session21 top pods

troubleshooting.name: troubleshooting-recovered
troubleshooting.command: kubectl -n session21 get pods,svc && curl -fsS http://localhost:8000/ready

cluster.name: helm
cluster.command: helm list -n session21 && helm status homework -n session21

cluster.name: gitops
cluster.command: kubectl -n argocd get application session21 && kubectl -n session21-gitops get pods,svc
